description_en: Queries the edges of the directed acyclic graph (DAG) for a task flow based on multiple conditions
description_zh: 调用ListTaskFlowEdgesByCondition接口，多条件获取指定任务流DAG图的边
name: ListTaskFlowEdgesByCondition

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

To view the ID of the tenant, go to the Data Management (DMS) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task flow. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html operation to query the task flow ID
parameters.help_zh: 任务流ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: dag_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task flow edge
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the start node on the edge
parameters.name: node_from

parameters.help_en: The ID of the end node on the edge
parameters.name: node_end
